For other uses|Yū}} {{Japanese name|off}} {{PrevNext |prev=Ready Go |next=Asleep or Awake |list=Japanese ending themes |colorscheme=ZA}} {{Song |type=HZ ED 05 |language=ja |title=尤 |transliterated=Yū |translated=YUU |screen=hd |screenshot=HZ ED 05.png |artist=ja |artistname=ゆず |artistname_ro={{wp|Yuzu (band)|Yuzu}} |lyricistname=北川悠仁 |lyricistname_ro=Yūjin Kitagawa |composername=北川悠仁、TeddyLoid、中しまりん |composername_ro=Yūjin Kitagawa, {{wp|TeddyLoid}}, Rin Nakashima |arrangername=TeddyLoid、ゆず |arrangername_ro=TeddyLoid, Yuzu |album=en |albumtype=single |albumtitle={{CD|GET BACK}} |catalognumber=TFCC-89797 |recordcompany=SENHA |colorscheme=ZA}} [[File:YUU cover.jpg|200px|thumb|right|Single cover]] '''YUU''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|尤|ゆう}}''' ''YUU'', lit. ''Superb'') is the Japanese theme song for ''[[Episode: Mega Evolution]]'' and the fifth ending song of {{aniseries|HZ}}. It debuted as an ending song in [[HZ112]], replacing [[Ready Go]]. The full version of the song was released on the {{CD|GET BACK}} CD and as a [[List of Pokémon digital singles#YUU|digital single]] on August 27, 2025. ==Ending animation: Version 1 ([[HZ112]])== [[File:HZ ED 05 HZ112.png|266px|thumb|right|Final shot from the HZ112 version]] ===Synopsis=== The ending animation consists of the scene panning over the following still images (in order): * A zoomed-in shot of [[Roy]]'s [[Mega Ring]], slowly zooming out * Roy, {{TP|Roy|Crocalor}}, and [[Captain Pikachu]] standing on a cliff side beside the [[Brave Olivine]], looking at the cloudy horizon * Roy, Cap, Crocalor, and {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}} on their journey * [[Master Mayonnaise]] telling some kids about a [[Heracronite]] * [[Emma]] and [[Emma's Espurr|Mimi]] putting up a missing poster for a {{p|Litleo}} on a signboard * [[Yellow Flash]] standing on the [[Lost Mayo Maze]] roof, looking into the distance * Roy, Crocalor, [[Ult]], and {{TP|Ult|Sableye}}, facing someone in a battle in the [[Lost Mayo Maze]] * Roy and Ult having a training battle * Emma serving food to Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon * Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon sleeping, with Ult having moved around so much in his sleep that his leg is poking Roy's face * The last shot is a continuation of the first one, zooming out fully to show Roy and his Pokémon with a determined expression. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Roy]] * [[Ult]] * [[Emma]] * [[Master Mayonnaise]] * [[Looker]] (photo) ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Crocalor}} ({{OP|Roy|Crocalor}}) * {{p|Kilowattrel}} ({{OP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Lucario}} ([[Yellow Flash]]; {{Shiny}}) * {{p|Sableye}} ({{OP|Ult|Sableye}}'s) * {{p|Espurr}} ([[Emma]]'s; [[Emma's Espurr|Mimi]]) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}; photo) * {{p|Escavalier}} ([[Count Hoisin]]'s) * {{p|Accelgor}} ([[Shōyu]]'s) * {{p|Litleo}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Dedenne}} (Trainer's) ==Ending animation: Version 2 ([[HZ113]])== [[File:HZ ED 05 HZ113.png|266px|thumb|right|Final shot from the HZ113 version]] ===Synopsis=== The ending animation consists of the scene panning over the following still images (in order): * A zoomed-in shot of [[Ult]]'s [[Mega Ring]], slowly zooming out * Ult and {{TP|Ult|Sableye}} sitting on a couch in the open while it rains * Ult walking on a busy street during this volunteer city cleaner gig * [[Master Mayonnaise]] telling some kids about a [[Heracronite]] * [[Emma]] and Mimi putting up a missing poster for a {{p|Litleo}} on a signboard * [[Yellow Flash]] standing on the [[Lost Mayo Maze]] roof, looking into the distance * Roy, Crocalor, [[Ult]], and {{TP|Ult|Sableye}} facing someone in a battle in the [[Lost Mayo Maze]] * Roy and Ult having a training battle * Emma serving food to Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon * Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon sleeping, with Ult having moved around so much in his sleep that his leg is poking Roy's face * The last shot is a continuation of the first one, zooming out fully to show Ult and his Sableye with an arrogant expression. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Roy]] * [[Ult]] * [[Emma]] * [[Master Mayonnaise]] * [[Looker]] (photo) * [[Lumiose City]] residents ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Sableye}} ({{OP|Ult|Sableye}}'s) * {{p|Crocalor}} ({{OP|Roy|Crocalor}}) * {{p|Kilowattrel}} ({{OP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Lucario}} ([[Yellow Flash]]; {{Shiny}}) * {{p|Espurr}} ([[Emma]]'s; Mimi) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}; photo) * {{p|Escavalier}} ([[Count Hoisin]]'s) * {{p|Accelgor}} ([[Shōyu]]'s) * {{p|Bunnelby}} (Trainer's) * {{P|Furfrou}} (Trainer's; {{fd|Furfrou|La Reine Trim}}) * {{p|Litleo}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Dedenne}} (Trainer's) ==Ending animation: Version 3 ([[HZ114]])== [[File:HZ ED 05 HZ114.png|266px|thumb|right|Final shot from the HZ114 version]] ===Synopsis=== The ending animation consists of the scene panning over the following still images (in order): * A zoomed-in shot of [[Roy]]'s [[Mega Ring]], slowly zooming out * [[Emma]] and Mimi welcoming back the partially offscreen [[Ult]] and [[Roy]] with a wave * Ult packing his bag while Roy is asleep, being helped by {{TP|Ult|Sableye}} * [[Master Mayonnaise]] telling some kids about a [[Heracronite]] * [[Emma]] and Mimi putting up a missing poster for a {{p|Litleo}} on a signboard * [[Count Hoisin]], {{p|Escavalier}}, [[Shōyu]], and {{p|Accelgor}} in the yard of the [[Lost Mayo Maze]], with Master Mayonnaise in his civilian attire in the background * Roy, {{TP|Roy|Crocalor}}, [[Captain Pikachu|Cap]], and {{TP|Roy|Lucario}} seemingly lost in [[Lumiose City]] alleys * Roy and Ult having a training battle * Emma serving food to Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon * Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon sleeping, with Ult having moved around so much in his sleep that his leg is poking Roy's face * The last shot is a continuation of the first one, zooming out fully to show Roy and his Pokémon with a determined expression. This shot is similar to the last from from the first version, updated to show Roy with his new jacket and without his hat, and now including his newly caught Lucario. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Roy]] * [[Ult]] * [[Emma]] * [[Master Mayonnaise]] * [[Count Hoisin]] * [[Shōyu]] * [[Looker]] (photo) ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Crocalor}} ({{OP|Roy|Crocalor}}) * {{p|Kilowattrel}} ({{OP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Lucario}} ({{OP|Roy|Lucario}}; {{Shiny}}) * {{p|Sableye}} ({{OP|Ult|Sableye}}'s) * {{p|Espurr}} ([[Emma]]'s; Mimi) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}; photo) * {{p|Escavalier}} ([[Count Hoisin]]'s) * {{p|Accelgor}} ([[Shōyu]]'s) * {{p|Litleo}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Dedenne}} (Trainer's) ==Variants== HZ ED 05 HZ112 01.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 02.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 03.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 04.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 05.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 06.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 07.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 08.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 09.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 10.png HZ ED 05 HZ112.png HZ ED 05 HZ113 01.png HZ ED 05 HZ113 02.png HZ ED 05 HZ113 03.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 04.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 05.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 06.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 07.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 08.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 09.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 10.png HZ ED 05 HZ113.png HZ ED 05 HZ114 01.png HZ ED 05 HZ114 02.png HZ ED 05 HZ114 03.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 04.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 05.png HZ ED 05 HZ114 06.png HZ ED 05 HZ114 07.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 08.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 09.png HZ ED 05 HZ112 10.png HZ ED 05 HZ114.png ==Lyrics== ===TV size=== {{Schemetable|ZA}} !
